title: Payment History Before Charge-Off: Charged-Off Settlement Plan Points
content:
> For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan on which the scheduled-installment payments ever posted, less the scheduled-installment payments returned, number at least 24 earns 5 points; a loan on which they number at least 12 but fewer than 24 earns 2 points; a loan with fewer earns none. The payments are those of the scheduled-installment type on the loan's whole Personal Loans payment ledger. Each point is one percentage point off the settlement percentage.

| Scheduled-installment payments ever posted, less those returned | Points |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 5 |
| 12 to 23 | 2 |
| 11 or fewer | none |

*Hypothetical counts:* 25 posted and 2 returned give 23, 2 points; 26 posted and 2 returned give 24, 5 points; 12 posted and 1 returned give 11, none.
